title: President Barack Obama's Rutgers Commencement Speech
speaker: Barack Obama

sentences.en: the most difficult and potentially catastrophic financial crisis the world has ever witnessed.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最困难和可能灾难性的金融危机。

sentences.en: In subsequent months, he cuts through the Gordian knot of health care reform and he dealt with the natural disasters both here and around the world.
sentences.zh: 在其后的几个月里,他缩短了保健改革的艰难节节,并处理了这里和世界各地的自然灾害。

sentences.en: During his presidency, he has championed clean energy, taken a strong action against climate change, and for his entire career, he has been a
sentences.zh: 在担任主席期间,他一直倡导清洁能源,对气候变化采取了强有力的行动。

sentences.en: tireless advocate of social justice and of access for all people to affordable education, quality health care, equal employment, and real hope for the
sentences.zh: 坚持不懈地倡导社会正义和人人有机会获得负担得起的教育、优质保健、平等就业,以及实现人人平等的真正希望。

sentences.en: future. But all of these challenges and President Obama's leadership uh in addressing them are well known to everyone in the audience. And if there was ever an occasion where the phrase
sentences.zh: 未来。但所有这些挑战 和奥巴马总统的领导 在解决这些问题 众所周知 在观众中。

sentences.en: "No introduction is necessary" was truly an understatement, this is it.
sentences.zh: "不需要介绍" 确实是一个轻描淡写,就是这样。

sentences.en: So without further ado, it is great pride and a feeling of deep humility um that I have the opportunity to present President Barack Obama, the 44th
sentences.zh: 因此,没有进一步的顾虑,这是巨大的自豪感 和一种深深的谦卑感 嗯,我有机会介绍 总统巴拉克奥巴马,第44届

sentences.en: President of the United States, with his honorary degree.
sentences.zh: 美国总统 荣誉学位

sentences.en: Barack H. Obama, by the authority vested in me by the Boards of Governors and Trustees of Rutgers, the State University of New Jersey, I am deeply honored to confer upon you the
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马,根据新泽西州立大学拉特格斯理事会和董事会授予我的权力,我非常荣幸地授予你以下权力:

sentences.en: degree of Doctor of Laws honoris causa with all the rights, responsibilities, privileges, and immunities to which it is entitled. In token of this, I present
sentences.zh: 荣誉法学博士学位,享有一切权利、责任、特权和豁免。

sentences.en: you with this diploma and direct that you be vested in the hood emblematic of the degree.
sentences.zh: 你拥有这个文凭 并指示你 被赋予了头罩 标志学位。

sentences.en: HELLO, RUTGERS! ARE YOU FIRED UP? THANK YOU SO MUCH. THANK YOU, EVERYBODY.
sentences.zh: 嗨,罗特斯,你被解雇了吗?

sentences.en: PLEASE have a seat. Thank you, President Barchi, for that introduction.
sentences.zh: 请坐,谢谢巴奇总统的介绍

sentences.en: Let me congratulate my extraordinarily worthy fellow honorary Scarlet Knights, Doctor Burnell
sentences.zh: 请允许我祝贺我杰出的荣誉同胞 斯嘉丽骑士,伯内尔博士

sentences.en: and Bill Moyers. Matthew, good job. If you are interested, we can talk after this.
sentences.zh: 比尔·莫耶斯 马修 干得漂亮 如果你有兴趣 我们可以在这之后再谈

sentences.en: One of the perks of my job is honorary degrees.
sentences.zh: 我工作的一个好处就是获得荣誉学位

sentences.en: But I have to tell you, it impresses nobody in my house.
sentences.zh: 但我得告诉你 这让我家里没人印象深刻

sentences.en: Malia and Sasha just say, "Okay, Doctor Dad.
sentences.zh: 马利亚和萨沙只是说, "好吧,爸爸医生。

sentences.en: We'll see you later. Can we have some money?"
sentences.zh: 回头见 我们能借点钱吗?"

sentences.en: To the Board of Governors, to Chairman Brown, to Lieutenant Governor Guadagno, Mayor Cahill, Mayor Waller, members of Congress,
sentences.zh: 致理事会、布朗主席、瓜达格诺副总督、卡希尔市长、瓦勒市长、国会议员,

sentences.en: Rutgers administrators, faculty, staff, friends, and family, thank you for the honor of joining you for the 250th anniversary of this remarkable
sentences.zh: Rutgers管理者、教职员、职员、朋友和家人, 感谢各位有幸与你们共度这一非凡的250周年

sentences.en: institution. But most of all, congratulations to the
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是,祝贺

sentences.en: CLASS OF 2016. I COME HERE FOR A simple reason,
sentences.zh: 2016年班级 我来这里的原因很简单

sentences.en: to finally settle this pork roll versus Taylor ham question.
sentences.zh: 终于解决了这个猪卷 对泰勒火腿的问题。

sentences.en: I'm just kidding. There's not much that I'm afraid to take on in my final year of office, but I know better than to get in the middle of that debate.
sentences.zh: 开玩笑的,我最怕在任期的最后一年接任

sentences.en: The truth is, Rutgers, I came here because you asked.
sentences.zh: 事实是，罗格斯大学，我来这里是因为你的要求。

sentences.en: Uh now, it's true that a lot of schools invite me to their commencement every year, but you are the first to launch a 3-year campaign.
sentences.zh: 呃现在确实有很多学校每年都会邀请我去参加他们的毕业典礼,但是你们是第一个发起为期三年的活动的。

sentences.en: Emails, letters, tweets, YouTube videos.
sentences.zh: 电子邮件、信件、推文、YouTube 视频。

sentences.en: I even got three notes from the grandmother of your student body president.
sentences.zh: 我什至收到了你们学生会主席祖母的三张便条。

sentences.en: And and I have to say that really sealed the deal. That was smart because I have a soft spot for grandmas.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，这确实促成了这笔交易。这很聪明，因为我对祖母情有独钟。

sentences.en: So I'm here off exit 9 on the banks of the old Raritan at the site of one of the original nine
sentences.zh: 所以我现在就在老 Raritan 河岸的 9 号出口处，位于最初的 9 号出口之一的所在地

sentences.en: colonial colleges, winners of the first ever COLLEGE FOOTBALL GAME, ONE OF THE NEWEST MEMBERS OF THE BIG
sentences.zh: 殖民地学院，第一届大学橄榄球比赛的获胜者，大联盟的最新成员之一

sentences.en: TEN, HOME OF WHAT I UNDERSTAND to be
sentences.zh: 十、我所理解的家园

sentences.en: a grease truck for a fat sandwich, mozzarella sticks and chicken fingers
sentences.zh: 运油车，用于装载肥三明治、马苏里拉奶酪条和鸡条

sentences.en: on your cheesesteaks. I'm sure Michelle would approve.
sentences.zh: 在你的奶酪牛排上。我相信米歇尔会同意的。

sentences.en: But somehow, you have survived such death-defying acts.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，你在这种玩命的行为中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: You also survived the daily jockeying for buses from Livingston to Busch to Cook to Douglass and back again.
sentences.zh: 您还经历了每天从利文斯顿到布希、库克和道格拉斯的巴士往返旅程。

sentences.en: I suspect that a few of you are trying to survive this afternoon after a late night at Old Queens.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑你们中的一些人在老皇后区度过了一个深夜后，今天下午正试图生存下去。

sentences.en: You know who you are. But
sentences.zh: 你知道你是谁。但是

sentences.en: however you got here, you made it. You made it. So today, you join a long line of Scarlet Knights whose energy and intellect have lifted
sentences.zh: 无论你到达这里，你都成功了。你做到了。所以今天，你加入了血色骑士的行列，他们的能量和智慧已经提升了

sentences.en: this university to heights its founders could not have imagined.
sentences.zh: 这所大学达到了其创始人无法想象的高度。

sentences.en: 250 years ago, when America was still just an idea, a charter from a royal governor, Ben Franklin's son,
sentences.zh: 250 年前，当美国还只是一个想法，是皇家总督、本·富兰克林之子的特许状时，

sentences.en: established Queen's College. A few years later, a handful of students gathered in a converted tavern for the first class.
sentences.zh: 成立皇后学院。几年后，少数学生聚集在一家改建的小酒馆里参加第一堂课。

sentences.en: And from that first class in a pub, Rutgers has evolved into one of the finest research institutions in America.
sentences.zh: 罗格斯大学从一家一流的酒吧发展成为美国最好的研究机构之一。

sentences.en: Today is a place where you 3D print prosthetic hands for children and devise rooftop wind arrays that can power entire office buildings with clean
sentences.zh: 今天，您可以为儿童 3D 打印假手，并设计屋顶风力阵列，为整个办公楼提供清洁能源

sentences.en: renewable energy. Every day, tens of thousands of students come here to this intellectual melting pot where ideas and cultures flow together
sentences.zh: 可再生能源。每天都有数以万计的学子来到这个思想与文化交融的知识熔炉

sentences.en: among what might just be America's most diverse student body.
sentences.zh: 其中可能是美国最多元化的学生群体之一。

sentences.en: Here in New Brunswick, you can debate philosophy with a classmate from South Asia in one class and then strike up a conversation on the double E bus with a first-generation Latina student from
sentences.zh: 在新不伦瑞克省，你可以在一节课上与来自南亚的同学辩论哲学，然后在双 E 巴士上与来自南亚的第一代拉丁裔学生展开对话。

sentences.en: Jersey City before sitting down for your site group project with a veteran who's going to school on the post-9/11 GI Bill.
sentences.zh: 泽西市，然后坐下来与一位退伍军人一起进行现场小组项目，这位退伍军人将在 9/11 后《退伍军人权利法案》中上学。

sentences.en: America converges here. And in so many ways, the history of Rutgers mirrors the evolution of America,
sentences.zh: 美国汇聚于此。在很多方面，罗格斯大学的历史反映了美国的演变，

sentences.en: the course by which we became bigger, stronger, and richer, and more dynamic, and a more inclusive nation.
sentences.zh: 以及我们变得更大、更强大、更富有、更有活力和更具包容性的国家。

sentences.en: But America's progress has never been smooth or steady.
sentences.zh: 但美国的进步从来就不是平滑或稳定。

sentences.en: Progress doesn't travel in a straight line.
sentences.zh: 进步不是直线前进的

sentences.en: It zigs and zags in fits and starts. Progress in America has been hard and contentious,
sentences.zh: 美国的进步既艰难又充满争议

sentences.en: and sometimes bloody. It remains uneven.
sentences.zh: 有时是血淋淋的 仍然很不平衡

sentences.en: And at times, for every two steps forward, it feels like we take one step back.
sentences.zh: 有时,对于前进的两步, 感觉我们退一步。

sentences.en: Now, for some of you, this may sound like your college career.
sentences.zh: 现在,对你们中的一些人来说,这听起来像是你的大学生涯。

sentences.en: It sounds like mine, anyway. Which makes sense because measured against the whole of human history, America remains a very young nation.
sentences.zh: 无论如何,这听起来像我的。这有道理,因为根据整个人类历史衡量,美国仍然是一个非常年轻的国家。

sentences.en: Younger even than this university. But progress is bumpy.
sentences.zh: 甚至比这所大学还年轻,但进步还是很不稳定的。

sentences.en: It always has been. But because of dreamers and innovators and strivers and activists, progress has been this nation's
sentences.zh: 但因为梦想者、创新者、奋斗者与活动家,

sentences.en: hallmark. I'm fond of quoting Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. who said, "The arc of the moral universe is long,
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢引用小马丁·路德·金博士的话

sentences.en: but it bends towards justice." It bends towards justice.
sentences.zh: 但它向正义倾斜" 它向正义倾斜

sentences.en: I believe that. But I also believe that the arc of our nation, the arc of the world does not bend towards justice or freedom or
sentences.zh: 但我也相信 我们国家的弧线 世界的弧线并不向正义或自由屈服

sentences.en: equality or prosperity on its own. It depends on us.
sentences.zh: 平等或繁荣取决于我们。

sentences.en: On the choices we make. Particularly at certain inflection points in history.
sentences.zh: 特别是历史的某些迷惑点

sentences.en: Particularly when big changes are happening and everything seems up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 特别是当大的变化 发生,一切都似乎 被抢走。

sentences.en: And class of 2016, you are graduating at such an inflection point.
sentences.zh: 2016年的班级,你即将毕业 在这样一个纠缠点。

sentences.en: Since the start of this new millennium, you've already witnessed horrific terrorist attacks and war and a great recession.
sentences.zh: 自从新千年开始以来 你已经目睹了可怕的恐怖袭击和战争 以及一场巨大的衰退

sentences.en: You've seen economic and technological and cultural shifts that are profoundly altering how we work and how we communicate,
sentences.zh: 你们已经看到经济、技术和文化的变化 深刻地改变了我们的工作方式 以及我们的交流方式

sentences.en: how we live, how we form families. The pace of change is not subsiding.
sentences.zh: 我们如何生活,如何组成家庭,变化的速度并没有减弱。

sentences.en: It is accelerating. And these changes offer not only great opportunity, but also great peril.
sentences.zh: 它正在加速。这些变化不仅提供了巨大的机会,而且也带来了巨大的危险。

sentences.en: Fortunately, your generation has everything it takes to lead this country toward a brighter future.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是,你们这一代人拥有领导这个国家走向更光明未来的一切能力。

sentences.en: I'm confident that you can make the right choices away from fear and division and paralysis and toward cooperation and innovation and hope.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们可以做出正确的选择 摆脱恐惧 分裂 瘫痪 合作 创新 和希望

sentences.en: Now, partly I'm confident because on average you're smarter and better educated than my generation.
sentences.zh: 我有点自信 因为平均来说 你比我这代人聪明 教育程度也高

sentences.en: Although we probably had better penmanship.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们可能写得更好

sentences.en: And we're certainly better spellers. We did not have spell check back in my day.
sentences.zh: 我们当然是更好的拼写者。我们以前没有拼写检查过。

sentences.en: You're not only better educated, you've been more exposed to the world.
sentences.zh: 你不仅受过更好的教育 更接触了这个世界

sentences.en: More exposed to other cultures. You're more diverse. You're more environmentally conscious.
sentences.zh: 更接触其他文化,你更多样化,你更有环保意识

sentences.en: You have a healthy skepticism for conventional wisdom.
sentences.zh: 你对传统智慧有健康的怀疑。

sentences.en: So you've got the tools to lead us. And precisely because I have so much confidence in you, I'm not going to spend the remainder of my time telling you exactly how you're going to make the world better.
sentences.zh: 所以你们有引导我们的工具。正是因为我对你有信心, 我不会花我剩下的时间来告诉你们 如何让世界变得更好。

sentences.en: You'll figure it out. You'll look at things with fresher eyes, unencumbered by the biases and blind
sentences.zh: 你会想出办法的,你会用新鲜的眼睛看事物, 不受偏向和盲目的影响

sentences.en: spots and inertia and general crankiness of your parents and grandparents and old heads like me.
sentences.zh: 斑点和惰性 以及你父母和祖父母 以及像我这样的老头一般的暴躁

sentences.en: But I do have a couple of suggestions uh that you may find useful as you go out there and conquer the world.
sentences.zh: 但我有几条建议,呃......你出去征服世界的时候 可能觉得有用

sentences.en: Point number one. When you hear someone longing for the good old days, take it with a grain of salt.
sentences.zh: 第一点 当你听到有人渴望过去的美好时光时

sentences.en: Take it with a grain OF SALT. WE LIVE IN A GREAT nation and we are rightly proud of our history.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个伟大的国家,我们理所当然地为我们的历史感到自豪。

sentences.en: We are beneficiaries of the labor and the grit and the courage of generations who came before.
sentences.zh: 我们是劳动的受益者,是前世后代的勇气和勇气的受益者。

sentences.en: But I guess it's part of human nature, especially in times of change and uncertainty, to want to look backwards and long for some imaginary past when everything
sentences.zh: 但我想这是人性的一部分, 特别是在变化和不确定的时候, 想要回过头来, 等待一些想象中的过去,当一切

sentences.en: worked and the economy hummed and all politicians were wise and every child was well-mannered and America pretty much did whatever it wanted
sentences.zh: 工作、经济 和所有的政治家都是明智的 每一个孩子都是有教养的 美国几乎做了任何它想要做的事

sentences.en: around the world. Guess what? It ain't so.
sentences.zh: 环游世界,你猜怎么着?

sentences.en: The good old days weren't all that good.
sentences.zh: 过去的好日子没那么好

sentences.en: Yes, there have been some stretches in our history where the economy grew much faster or when government ran more smoothly.
sentences.zh: 是的,在我们的历史中,有些时期 经济增长速度快得多,或者政府运行更顺利。

sentences.en: There were moments when immediately after World War II, for example, or at the end of the Cold War, when the world bent more easily to our will.
sentences.zh: 例如,在第二次世界大战刚结束的时候,或者在冷战结束的时候,世界更容易接受我们的意愿。

sentences.en: But those are sporadic, those moments, those episodes.
sentences.zh: 但是,那些是零星的,那些时刻,那些事件。

sentences.en: In fact, by almost every measure, America is better and the world is better than it was 50 years ago or 30 years ago or even eight
sentences.zh: 事实上,几乎每个尺度,美国都好,世界也好于50年前或30年前,甚至8年前。

sentences.en: years ago. And and by the way, I I'm not I'm not
sentences.zh: 多年前,顺便说一句,我不是

sentences.en: So set aside 150 years ago, pre-Civil War. There's a whole bunch of stuff there we could talk about.
sentences.zh: 150年前的内战前,我们可以讨论很多事情

sentences.en: Set aside life in the '50s when women and people of color were systematically excluded from big chunks of American life.
sentences.zh: 将50年代的生活抛在一边 那时女性和有色人种 被系统地排除在美国生活的大块之外

sentences.en: Since I graduated in 1983, which isn't that long ago.
sentences.zh: 自从我1983年毕业, 不久以前。

sentences.en: I'm just saying. Since I graduated, crime rates, teenage pregnancy, the share of Americans living in
sentences.zh: 我只是说 自从我毕业后 犯罪率 少女怀孕 美国人在

sentences.en: poverty, they're all down. The share of Americans with college educations have gone way up.
sentences.zh: 美国人接受大学教育的比例已经上升了

sentences.en: Our life expectancy has as well. Blacks and Latinos have risen up the ranks in business and politics.
sentences.zh: 黑人和拉丁人提升了商业和政治地位。

sentences.en: More women are in the workforce. They're earning more money.
sentences.zh: 更多的妇女加入劳动大军,她们挣的钱更多。

sentences.en: Although it's long past time that we pass laws to make sure that women are getting the same pay for the same work as men.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们已经很久没有通过法律了 以确保女性得到与男性同样的报酬

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in eight years since most of you started high school, we're also better off.
sentences.zh: 同时,八年来,你们大多数人 开始高中, 我们也更好了。

sentences.en: You and your fellow graduates are entering the job market with better prospects than anytime since 2007.
sentences.zh: 你和你的同校毕业生进入就业市场的前景比2007年任何时候都好。

sentences.en: 20 million more Americans know the financial security of health insurance.
sentences.zh: 又有两千万美国人知道医疗保险的财政保障。

sentences.en: We're less dependent on foreign oil. We've doubled the protection of clean energy. We have cut the high school dropout rate. We've cut the deficit by two-thirds. Marriage equality is the law
sentences.zh: 我们不那么依赖外国石油。 我们已经把清洁能源的保护增加了一倍。我们已经降低了高中辍学率。我们已经把赤字减少了三分之二。婚姻平等是法律。

sentences.en: OF THE LAND. AND JUST AS AMERICA'S BETTER, THE world
sentences.zh: 和像美国更好的,世界

sentences.en: is better than when I graduated. Since I graduated, an iron curtain fell.
sentences.zh: 比我毕业时好多了 自从毕业后 铁幕掉下来了

sentences.en: Apartheid ended. There's more democracy. We virtually eliminated certain diseases like polio.
sentences.zh: 种族隔离结束了 民主越多 我们几乎消灭了脊髓灰质炎等疾病

sentences.en: We've cut extreme poverty drastically. We've cut infant mortality by an enormous amount.
sentences.zh: 我们大幅削减了极度贫困, 将婴儿死亡率大幅降低。

sentences.en: Now, I say all these things not to make you complacent.
sentences.zh: 现在,我说所有这些事情 让你不自满。

sentences.en: We got a bunch of big problems to solve.
sentences.zh: 我们有一大堆问题要解决

sentences.en: But I say it to point out that change has been a constant in our history and the reason America's better is because we didn't look backwards.
sentences.zh: 但是我要指出的是,变革一直是我们历史的常态, 美国之所以更好, 是因为我们没有回头看。

sentences.en: We didn't fear the future. We seized the future and made it our own.
sentences.zh: 我们并不害怕未来 我们抓住了未来 把它变成了我们自己的未来

sentences.en: And that's exactly why it's always been young people like you that have brought about big change.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此 总是像你这样的年轻人 带来了巨大的变化

sentences.en: Because you don't fear the future. And that leads me to my second point.

sentences.zh: 2014年,有五分之一的年轻人参加投票。

sentences.en: And the four who stayed home determined the course of this country just as much as the single one who voted because apathy has consequences.
sentences.zh: 留在家中的四人决定了这个国家的走向 和因为冷漠而投票的单一人一样

sentences.en: It determines who our Congress is. It determines what policies they prioritize.
sentences.zh: 它决定我们的国会是谁,决定他们优先考虑的政策。

sentences.en: It even, for example, determines whether a really highly qualified Supreme Court nominee receives the courtesy of a hearing and a vote in the United States Senate.
sentences.zh: 例如,它甚至决定一个真正高素质的最高法院提名人是否获得美国参议院的听证和投票。

sentences.en: AND YES. YES, big money is big money in politics is a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 是的,大钱是大钱 在政治上是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: We've got to reduce its influence. Yes, special interests and lobbyists have disproportionate access to the corridors of power. But contrary to what we hear sometimes from both the left as
sentences.zh: 是的,特殊利益集团和游说者 进入权力走廊的机会不相称

sentences.en: well as the right the system isn't as rigged as you think and it certainly is not as hopeless as you think.
sentences.zh: 以及正确的系统 并不像你想象的那样被操纵 而且它肯定没有你想象的那么绝望。

sentences.en: Politicians care about being elected. And they especially care about being reelected. And if you vote and you elect a majority that represents your views, you will get what you want. And if you
sentences.zh: 政客关心的是当选。他们特别关心的是重新当选。如果你们投票并选出代表自己观点的多数,你们就会得到你想要的东西。

sentences.en: opt out or stop paying attention, you won't.
sentences.zh: 选择退出或停止关注, 你不会的。

sentences.en: It's that simple. IT'S NOT THAT COMPLICATED.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单,不是那么简单

sentences.en: NOW, ONE OF THE REASONS THAT PEOPLE DON'T vote is because they don't see the changes they were looking for right away.
sentences.zh: 现在,人们不投票的原因之一是 他们看不到他们想要的改变

sentences.en: Well, guess what? None of the great strides in our history happened right away.
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着 我们历史上的重大进步 都没有马上发生

sentences.en: It took Thurgood Marshall and the N NAACP decades to win Brown versus Board of Education. And then another decade after that to secure the Civil Rights Act and the Voting Rights Act.
sentences.zh: 索古德·马歇尔(Thurgood Marshall)和N NAACP(N NAACP)花了几十年才赢得布朗对教育局的胜利。 在那之后又十年才能获得《民权法案》和《投票权法案》。

sentences.en: And it took a It took more time after that for to start working.
sentences.zh: 之后花了更多的时间才开始工作。

sentences.en: It took a proud daughter of New Jersey, Alice Paul, years of organizing marches and hunger strikes and protests and drafting hundreds of pieces of legislation and writing letters and
sentences.zh: 新泽西的一个骄傲的女儿Alice Paul 组织游行和绝食抗议 起草数以百计的立法 写了信

sentences.en: giving speeches and working with congressional leaders before she and other suffragists finally helped
sentences.zh: 在她和其他窒息者最终帮助她之前 发表演讲和与国会领导人合作

sentences.en: win women the right to vote. Each stage along the way of required compromise.
sentences.zh: 妇女赢得投票权,每个阶段都必须达成妥协。

sentences.en: Sometimes you took half a loaf. You forged allies.
sentences.zh: 有时你拿了半块面包,你们是盟友

sentences.en: Sometimes you lost on an issue and then you came back to fight another day.
sentences.zh: 有时你因为一个问题输了 然后又回来打一场仗

sentences.en: That's how democracy works. So, you've got to be committed to participating not just if you get immediate gratification, but
sentences.zh: 民主就是这样运作的。所以,你必须致力于参与, 不仅仅是当你得到 立即的满足,但

sentences.en: you got to be a citizen full-time all the time.
sentences.zh: 你总是要当全职公民

sentences.en: And if participation means voting and it means compromise and organizing and advocacy, it also means listening to those who don't agree with you.
sentences.zh: 如果参与意味着投票 意味着妥协 组织和宣传 也意味着倾听那些不同意你的人的意见

sentences.en: I know a couple of years ago, folks some folks on this campus got upset that Condoleezza Rice was supposed to speak at a commencement.
sentences.zh: 我知道几年前 校园里有人 担心康多莉扎·赖斯要开场发言

sentences.en: Now I don't think it's a secret that I disagree with many of the foreign policies of Dr. Rice in the previous administration.
sentences.zh: 现在,我不认为这是一个秘密 我不同意许多外交政策 赖斯博士在上届政府。

sentences.en: But the notion that this community or the country would be better served by not hearing from a former Secretary of State or shutting out what she had to say
sentences.zh: 但是这个社区或国家 最好不要听前国务卿的话 或拒绝她的话

sentences.en: I believe that's misguided. I don't think that's how democracy works best when we're not even willing to listen TO EACH OTHER.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是错误的。我认为,当我们甚至不愿意听别人的话时,民主是不会这么好的。

sentences.en: I BELIEVE THAT'S MISGUIDED. IF YOU DISAGREE WITH SOMEBODY, bring them in and ASK THEM TOUGH QUESTIONS.
sentences.zh: 如果你和别人不和 带他们进来问问题

sentences.en: HOLD THEIR FEET TO THE FIRE. Make them defend their positions.
sentences.zh: 把他们的脚放在炮火上 让他们守住阵地

sentences.en: If somebody's got a bad or offensive idea, prove it wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果有人有坏主意或攻击性想法 证明是错的

sentences.en: Engage it. Debate it. Stand up for what you believe in.
sentences.zh: 开战 辩论 站起来 支持你的信仰

sentences.en: Don't be scared to take somebody on. Don't feel like you got to shut your ears off because you're too fragile and somebody might offend your sensibilities. Go at them
sentences.zh: 别害怕,别害怕,别觉得你太脆弱了 可能有人会冒犯你的感情

sentences.en: if they're not making any sense. Use your logic and reason and words.
sentences.zh: 如果他们说不通的话 就用你的逻辑、理性和语言

sentences.en: And by doing so, you'll strengthen your own position.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做,你会加强你自己的地位。

sentences.en: And you'll hone your arguments. And maybe you'll learn something and realize you don't know everything and you may have a new understanding not only about what your opponents believe but maybe
sentences.zh: 并且你将讨论你的争论。也许你会学到一些东西, 并且意识到你并不了解一切, 你可能会有一种新的理解, 不仅你的对手们相信什么,而且也许

sentences.en: what you believe. Either way, you win. And more importantly, our democracy wins.
sentences.zh: 不管怎么说,你赢了 更重要的是,我们的民主赢了

sentences.en: So, anyway, I know uh That's it, class of 2016.
sentences.zh: 所以,不管怎样,我知道 嗯,就是这样,2016年班。

sentences.en: A few suggestions on how you can change the world.
sentences.zh: 关于如何改变世界的一些建议。

sentences.en: Except maybe I've got one last suggestion. And just one.
sentences.zh: 除了也许我还有最后一个建议 只有一个

sentences.en: And that is gear yourself for the long haul.
sentences.zh: 这是你长期的准备。

sentences.en: Whatever path you choose, business, nonprofits, government, education, health care, the arts, whatever it is,
sentences.zh: 无论你选择什么道路, 商业,非营利, 政府,教育,保健, 艺术,不管它是什么,

sentences.en: you're going to have some setbacks. You will deal occasionally with foolish people.
sentences.zh: 你会遇到一些挫折 你偶尔会和蠢人打交道

sentences.en: You will be frustrated. You'll have a boss that's not great.
sentences.zh: 你会很沮丧的 你会有一个不好的老板

sentences.en: You won't always get everything you want.
sentences.zh: 你不会总是得到你想要的一切。

sentences.en: At least not as fast as you want it. So, you have you have to stick with it.
sentences.zh: 至少没有你想的那么快 所以你得坚持下去

sentences.en: You have to be persistent. And success, however small, however incomplete, success is still
sentences.zh: 你必须坚持到底 成功无论多么小 多么不完整 成功仍然是

sentences.en: success. It's I always tell my daughters, you know, better is good.
sentences.zh: 成功。我总是告诉我的女儿,你知道,更好是好的。

sentences.en: It may not be great, perfect, it may not be great, but it's good. That's how progress happens in societies and in our own lives.
sentences.zh: 它可能不是伟大的, 完美的,它可能不是伟大的, 但它是好的。这就是如何在社会和我们自己的生活中 取得进步。

sentences.en: So, don't lose hope if sometimes you hit a roadblock.
sentences.zh: 所以,不要失去希望 如果有时你撞上路障。

sentences.en: Don't lose hope in the face of naysayers.
sentences.zh: 别在反证者面前失去希望

sentences.en: And certainly don't let resistance make you cynical.
sentences.zh: 当然别让抵抗 让你变得愤世嫉俗

sentences.en: Cynicism is so easy. And cynics don't accomplish much.
sentences.zh: 愤世嫉俗很简单 愤世嫉俗也没什么用

sentences.en: As as a friend of mine who happens to be from New Jersey, a guy named Bruce Springsteen uh once sang, "They spend their lives waiting for a
sentences.zh: 作为我的朋友 碰巧从新泽西州, 一个叫布鲁斯・斯普林斯汀的家伙 曾经唱,"他们花一生 等待一个

sentences.en: moment that just don't come." Don't let that be you.
sentences.zh: 那一刻,只是不来。" 不要让那是你。

sentences.en: Don't waste your time waiting. And if you doubt you can make a difference, look at the impact some of your fellow graduates are already making. Look at what Matthews is doing.
sentences.zh: 别浪费时间等待。如果你怀疑自己能有所作为的话, 看看你们的一些毕业生已经产生了什么影响。看看马修斯在做什么。

sentences.en: Look at somebody like uh Yasmin Ramadan who began organizing anti-bullying assemblies when she was 10 years old to help kids handle bias and discrimination. And here at Rutgers
sentences.zh: 看看像厄·亚斯敏·拉马丹这样的人,她10岁时就开始组织反欺凌集会,帮助孩子处理偏见和歧视。

sentences.en: helped found the Muslim Public Relations Council to work with administrators and police to promote inclusion.
sentences.zh: 帮助穆斯林公共关系委员会与行政人员和警察合作,促进包容。

sentences.en: Look at somebody like Madison Little who grew up dealing with some health issues and started wondering what his care would have been like if he lived someplace else. And so, here at Rutgers, he took charge of a student nonprofit
sentences.zh: 看看像麦迪逊·李特这样的人 长大后处理一些健康问题 开始想如果他住在别的地方会是什么样子

sentences.en: and worked with folks in Australia, Cambodia, and Uganda to address the AIDS epidemic.
sentences.zh: 并与澳大利亚、柬埔寨和乌干达人民合作,解决艾滋病流行问题。

sentences.en: "Our generation has so much energy to adapt and impact the world," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说,“我们这一代人有这么多的精力来适应和影响世界。”

sentences.en: "My peers give me a lot of hope that we'll overcome the obstacles we face in society."
sentences.zh: "我的同行们给了我很多希望, 希望我们能克服我们在社会上所面临的障碍"

sentences.en: That's you. Is it any wonder that I'm optimistic?
sentences.zh: 那就是你,我这么乐观有什么奇怪吗?

sentences.en: Throughout our history, a new generation of Americans has reached up and bent the arc of history in the direction of more freedom and more opportunity and more justice.
sentences.zh: 在我们的整个历史中,新一代的美国人已经走到了前面,并且把历史的轴心转向了更多的自由和机会以及更多的正义的方向。

sentences.en: And class of 2016, it is your turn now to shape our nation's destiny as well as your own. So, get to work.
sentences.zh: 2016年的班级,现在轮到你来塑造我们国家的命运和你自己的命运。所以,开始工作吧。

sentences.en: Make sure the next 250 years are better than the last. Good luck. God bless you.
sentences.zh: 确保接下来的250年比过去更好 祝你好运 上帝保佑你

sentences.en: God bless this country we love. THANK YOU.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑我们所爱的国家 谢谢

sentences.en: THANK YOU, EVERYBODY. WOO!
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家
